566        public static void verifyFactionData() {
567                for (FactionAPI faction : Global.getSector().getAllFactions()) {
568                        verifyFactionData(faction);
569                }
570        }
571        
572        public static void verifyFactionData(FactionAPI faction) {
573                for (String id : faction.getKnownShips()) {
574                        if (Global.getSettings().getHullSpec(id) == null) {
575                                throw new RuntimeException("Hull with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
576                        }
577                }
578                for (String id : faction.getKnownHullMods()) {
579                        if (Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id) == null) {
580                                throw new RuntimeException("Hullmod with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
581                        }
582                }
583                for (String id : faction.getKnownIndustries()) {
584                        if (Global.getSettings().getIndustrySpec(id) == null) {
585                                throw new RuntimeException("Industry with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
586                        }
587                }
588                for (String id : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
589                        if (Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(id) == null) {
590                                throw new RuntimeException("Fighter wing with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
591                        }
592                }
593                for (String id : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
594                        if (Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(id) == null) {
595                                throw new RuntimeException("Weapon with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
596                        }
597                }
598                
599                for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(faction.getDoctrine().getCommanderSkills())) {
600                        if (Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(id) == null) {
601                                // making still-useful saves work... 9/15/2020
602                                if (id.equals("fighter_doctrine")) {
603                                        faction.getDoctrine().getCommanderSkills().remove(id);
604                                } else {
605                                        throw new RuntimeException("Commander skill with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
606                                }
607                        }
608                }
609                for (String id : new ArrayList<String>(faction.getDoctrine().getOfficerSkills())) {
610                        if (Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(id) == null) {
611                                throw new RuntimeException("Officer skill with id [" + id + "] not found for faction [" + faction.getId() + "]");
612                        }
613                }
614        }

1240        public static void addJunk(MarketAPI market) {
1241                SectorEntityToken entity = market.getPrimaryEntity();
1242                if (entity == null) return;
1243                LocationAPI location = entity.getContainingLocation();
1244                if (location == null) return;
1245                
1246                int numJunk = 5 + market.getSize() * 5;
1247                if (market.getSize() < 5) {
1248                        numJunk = (int) Math.max(1, numJunk * 0.5f);
1249                }
1250                float radius = entity.getRadius() + 100f;
1251                float minOrbitDays = radius / 20;
1252                float maxOrbitDays = minOrbitDays + 10f;
1253                
1254                location.addOrbitalJunk(entity,
1255                                 "orbital_junk", // from custom_entities.json 
1256                                 numJunk, // num of junk
1257                                 12, 20, // min/max sprite size (assumes square)
1258                                 radius, // orbit radius
1259                                 //70, // orbit width
1260                                 110, // orbit width
1261                                 minOrbitDays, // min orbit days
1262                                 maxOrbitDays, // max orbit days
1263                                 60f, // min spin (degress/day)
1264                                 360f); // max spin (degrees/day)
1265        }

1267        public static void addRuinsJunk(SectorEntityToken planet) {
1268                boolean r1 = planet.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.RUINS_SCATTERED);
1269                boolean r2 = planet.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.RUINS_WIDESPREAD);
1270                boolean r3 = planet.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.RUINS_EXTENSIVE);
1271                boolean r4 = planet.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.RUINS_VAST);
1272                
1273                if (!(r1 || r2 || r3 || r4)) return;
1274                
1275                int numJunk = 5;
1276                if (r2) numJunk += 5;
1277                if (r3) numJunk += 15;
1278                if (r4) numJunk += 40;
1279                
1280                //System.out.println("With ruins: " + planet.getName() + ", " + location.getNameWithLowercaseType());
1281                
1282                float radius = planet.getRadius() + 100f;
1283                float minOrbitDays = radius / 20;
1284                float maxOrbitDays = minOrbitDays + 10f;
1285                
1286                planet.getContainingLocation().addOrbitalJunk(planet,
1287                                 "orbital_junk", // from custom_entities.json 
1288                                 numJunk, // num of junk
1289                                 12, 20, // min/max sprite size (assumes square)
1290                                 radius, // orbit radius
1291                                 //70, // orbit width
1292                                 110, // orbit width
1293                                 minOrbitDays, // min orbit days
1294                                 maxOrbitDays, // max orbit days
1295                                 60f, // min spin (degress/day)
1296                                 360f); // max spin (degrees/day)
1297        }

1299        protected void addJunk() {
1300                junkList.clear();
1301                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
1302                        addJunk(market);
1303                }
1304                
1305                for (SectorEntityToken planet : Global.getSector().getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.PLANET)) {
1306                        LocationAPI location = planet.getContainingLocation();
1307                        if (location == null) continue;
1308                        
1309                        if (planet.getMarket() == null || !planet.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
1310                        
1311                        addRuinsJunk(planet);
1312                }
1313        }

1646        public static void dedupePortraits(List<PersonAPI> people) {
1647                for (int i = 0; i < 10 * people.size(); i++) {
1648                        if (hasDuplicatePortraits(people)) {
1649                                for (PersonAPI person : people) {
1650//                                      if (person.getNameString().equals("Abasi Ganymede")) {
1651//                                              System.out.println("efwfwef");
1652//                                      }
1653                                        if (person.isDefault() || person.isAICore() || person.isPlayer()) continue;
1654                                        int num = getPortraitCount(people, person);
1655                                        if (num > 1) {
1656                                                for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
1657                                                        regenPortrait(person);
1658                                                        num = getPortraitCount(people, person);
1659                                                        if (num <= 1) break;
1660                                                }
1661                                                Collections.shuffle(people, StarSystemGenerator.random);
1662                                                break;
1663                                        }
1664                                }
1665                        }
1666                }
1667        }

1669        public static void regenPortrait(PersonAPI person) {
1670                if (person == null || person.getFaction() == null) return;
1671                
1672                String curr = person.getPortraitSprite();
1673                if (curr == null) curr = "";
1674                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
1675                        String other = person.getFaction().createRandomPerson(person.getGender(), StarSystemGenerator.random).getPortraitSprite();
1676                        if (!curr.equals(other)) {
1677                                person.setPortraitSprite(other);
1678                                break;
1679                        }
1680                }
1681        }
1682        
1683        public static int getPortraitCount(List<PersonAPI> people, PersonAPI person) {
1684                String curr = person.getPortraitSprite();
1685                int count = 0;
1686                for (PersonAPI other : people) {
1687                        String str = other.getPortraitSprite();
1688                        if (str == null) continue;
1689                        if (curr.equals(str)) count++;
1690                }
1691                return count;
1692        }
1693        
1694        public static boolean hasDuplicatePortraits(List<PersonAPI> people) {
1695                Set<String> used = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
1696                for (PersonAPI person : people) {
1697                        String str = person.getPortraitSprite();
1698                        if (used.contains(str)) return true;
1699                        used.add(str);
1700                }
1701                return false;
1702        }

1707                {

1775        public static void addSkillsAndAssignAdmin(MarketAPI market, PersonAPI admin) {
1776                List<String> skills = Global.getSettings().getSortedSkillIds();
1777//              if (!skills.contains(Skills.PLANETARY_OPERATIONS) ||
1778//                              !skills.contains(Skills.SPACE_OPERATIONS) ||
1779//                              !skills.contains(Skills.INDUSTRIAL_PLANNING)) {
1780//                      return;
1781//              }
1782                if (!skills.contains(Skills.INDUSTRIAL_PLANNING)) {
1783                        return;
1784                }
1785                
1786                int size = market.getSize();
1787                //if (size <= 4) return;
1788                
1789                int industries = 0;
1790                
1791                for (Industry curr : market.getIndustries()) {
1792                        if (curr.isIndustry()) {
1793                                industries++;
1794                        }
1795                }
1796                
1797                
1798                admin.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
1799                
1800                if (industries >= 2 || size >= 6) {
1801                        admin.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.INDUSTRIAL_PLANNING, 1);
1802                }
1803                
1804                admin.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
1805                admin.getStats().refreshCharacterStatsEffects();
1806                
1807                market.setAdmin(admin);
1808        }

3183        public PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin> pickShipAI(FleetMemberAPI member, ShipAPI ship) {
3184                if (ship.isFighter()) {
3185                        if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_SWARM_AI)) {
3186                                return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(new ThreatSwarmAI(ship), PickPriority.CORE_SPECIFIC);
3187                        }
3188                        if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_VORTEX)) {
3189                                return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(new ShroudedVortexAI(ship), PickPriority.CORE_SPECIFIC);
3190                        }
3191                        if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_EJECTA)) {
3192                                return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(new ShroudedEjectaAI(ship), PickPriority.CORE_SPECIFIC);
3193                        }
3194                        return null;
3195                }
3196                
3197                
3198                if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT)) {
3199                        ShipAIConfig config = new ShipAIConfig(ship);
3200                        
3201                        //boolean overseer = ship.getHullSpec().getHullId().equals("overseer_unit");
3202                        
3203                        if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_TIMID)) {
3204                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.TIMID;
3205                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_CAUTIOUS)) {
3206                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.CAUTIOUS;
3207                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_AGGRESSIVE)) {
3208                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.AGGRESSIVE;
3209//                              config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
3210//                              config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
3211//                              config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
3212//                              config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
3213                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.THREAT_RECKLESS)) {
3214                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.RECKLESS;
3215                                config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
3216                                config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
3217                                config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
3218                                config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
3219                        } else {
3220                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.STEADY;
3221                        }
3222                        
3223                        PickPriority priority = PickPriority.CORE_SET;
3224                        return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(Global.getSettings().createDefaultShipAI(ship, config), priority);
3225                }
3226                
3227                if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER)) {
3228                        ShipAIConfig config = new ShipAIConfig(ship);
3229                        
3230                        if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_TIMID)) {
3231                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.TIMID;
3232                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_CAUTIOUS)) {
3233                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.CAUTIOUS;
3234                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_AGGRESSIVE)) {
3235                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.AGGRESSIVE;
3236                        } else if (ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_RECKLESS)) {
3237                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.RECKLESS;
3238                                config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
3239                                config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
3240                                config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
3241                                config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
3242                        } else {
3243                                config.personalityOverride = Personalities.STEADY;
3244                        }
3245                        
3246                        PickPriority priority = PickPriority.CORE_SET;
3247                        return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(Global.getSettings().createDefaultShipAI(ship, config), priority);
3248                }
3249                
3250                
3251                
3252                Set<String> derelicts = new HashSet<String>();
3253                derelicts.add("warden");
3254                derelicts.add("defender");
3255                derelicts.add("picket");
3256                derelicts.add("sentry");
3257                derelicts.add("berserker");
3258                derelicts.add("bastillion");
3259
3260                boolean zigguratOnEnemySide = ship.getHullSpec().getHullId().equals("ziggurat") && 
3261                                                        (member == null || member.getFleetCommander() == null || !member.getFleetCommander().isPlayer());
3262                
3263                String hullId = ship.getHullSpec().getHullId();
3264                if (!zigguratOnEnemySide && 
3265                                !derelicts.contains(hullId) && !Misc.isAutomated(ship.getVariant())) return null;
3266                
3267                //HullSize size = ship.getHullSize();
3268                
3269                ShipAIConfig config = new ShipAIConfig(ship);
3270                config.alwaysStrafeOffensively = true;
3271                config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = false;
3272                config.turnToFaceWithUndamagedArmor = false;
3273                config.burnDriveIgnoreEnemies = true;
3274                
3275                boolean carrier = false;
3276                if (ship != null && ship.getVariant() != null) {
3277                        carrier = ship.getVariant().isCarrier() && !ship.getVariant().isCombat();
3278                }
3279                if (carrier) {
3280                        config.personalityOverride = Personalities.AGGRESSIVE;
3281                        config.backingOffWhileNotVentingAllowed = true;
3282                } else {
3283                        config.personalityOverride = Personalities.RECKLESS;
3284                }
3285                
3286                PickPriority priority = PickPriority.CORE_SET;
3287                if (zigguratOnEnemySide) {
3288                        priority = PickPriority.CORE_SPECIFIC;
3289                }
3290                return new PluginPick<ShipAIPlugin>(Global.getSettings().createDefaultShipAI(ship, config), priority);
3291        }

3303        public void convertTo0951aSkillSystemIfNeeded() {
3304                if (Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getSavefileVersion() != null) {
3305                        return;
3306                }
3307                
3308                SectorAPI engine = Global.getSector();
3309                engine.getCharacterData().setSavefileVersion("0.95.1a");
3310                
3311                for (AdminData admin : engine.getCharacterData().getAdmins()) {
3312                        convertPersonSkillsTo0951a(admin.getPerson());
3313                }
3314        
3315                List<LocationAPI> all = new ArrayList<LocationAPI>();
3316                all.add(engine.getHyperspace());
3317                all.addAll(engine.getStarSystems());
3318                for (LocationAPI curr : all) {
3319                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : curr.getFleets()) {
3320                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
3321                                        convertPersonSkillsTo0951a(member.getCaptain());
3322                                        if (fleet.isPlayerFleet() && member.getCaptain().isAICore()) {
3323                                                String aiCoreId = member.getCaptain().getAICoreId();
3324                                                boolean alpha = Commodities.ALPHA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
3325                                                boolean beta = Commodities.BETA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
3326                                                boolean gamma = Commodities.GAMMA_CORE.equals(aiCoreId);
3327                                                
3328                                                int points = 0;
3329                                                float mult = 1f;
3330                                                if (alpha) {
3331                                                        points = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.ALPHA_POINTS;
3332                                                        mult = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.ALPHA_MULT;
3333                                                } else if (beta) {
3334                                                        points = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.BETA_POINTS;
3335                                                        mult = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.BETA_MULT;
3336                                                } else if (gamma) {
3337                                                        points = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.GAMMA_POINTS;
3338                                                        mult = AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.GAMMA_MULT;
3339                                                }
3340                                                member.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.AUTOMATED_POINTS_VALUE);
3341                                                member.getCaptain().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(AICoreOfficerPluginImpl.AUTOMATED_POINTS_MULT, mult);
3342                                        }
3343                                }
3344                        }
3345                }
3346                
3347                for (LocationAPI curr : all) {
3348                        for (SectorEntityToken entity : curr.getAllEntities()) {
3349                                if (entity.getMarket() != null && entity.getMarket().getAdmin() != null) { 
3350                                        convertPersonSkillsTo0951a(entity.getMarket().getAdmin());
3351                                }
3352                                if (entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null && entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains("$defenderFleet")) {
3353                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get("$defenderFleet");
3354                                        if (fleet != null) {
3355                                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
3356                                                        convertPersonSkillsTo0951a(member.getCaptain());
3357                                                }
3358                                        }
3359                                }
3360                        }
3361                }
3362                
3363                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = engine.getPlayerStats();
3364                int skillPoints = 0;
3365                int storyPoints = 0;
3366                for (SkillLevelAPI sl : stats.getSkillsCopy()) {
3367                        int level = (int) sl.getLevel();
3368                        if (level > 0) skillPoints++;
3369                        if (level > 1) storyPoints++;
3370                        for (int i = 0; i < level; i++) {
3371                                stats.decreaseSkill(sl.getSkill().getId());
3372                        }
3373                }
3374                stats.setPoints(stats.getPoints() + skillPoints);
3375                stats.setStoryPoints(stats.getStoryPoints() + storyPoints);
3376                stats.refreshCharacterStatsEffects();
3377                stats.refreshAllOutpostsEffectsForPlayerOutposts();
3378                
3379                engine.addTransientScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3380                        int frames = 0;
3381                        boolean done = false;
3382                        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
3383                                return true;
3384                        }
3385                        public boolean isDone() {
3386                                return done;
3387                        }
3388                        public void advance(float amount) {
3389                                frames++;
3390                                if (frames > 2 && !Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().isShowingDialog()) {
3391                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().showConfirmDialog("Your skills have been reset "
3392                                                        + "to accomodate the new skill system. Skill and story points have been refunded.\n\n"
3393                                                        + "Officer, administrator, and AI core skills have been adjusted for the new system.",
3394                                                        "Ok", null, null, null);
3395                                        done = true;
3396                                }
3397                        }
3398                });
3399        }

3401        @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
3402        public void convertPersonSkillsTo0951a(PersonAPI person) {
3403                if (person == null || person.isPlayer() || person.isDefault()) return;
3404                
3405                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = person.getStats();
3406                stats.setSkipRefresh(true);
3407                
3408                convertSkill(Skills.SHIELD_MODULATION, Skills.FIELD_MODULATION, person);
3409                convertSkill(Skills.RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING, Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, person);
3410                
3411                convertSkill(Skills.STRIKE_COMMANDER, Skills.HELMSMANSHIP, person);
3412                convertSkill(Skills.STRIKE_COMMANDER, Skills.POLARIZED_ARMOR, person);
3413                
3414                convertSkill(Skills.RANGED_SPECIALIZATION, Skills.TARGET_ANALYSIS, person);
3415                convertSkill(Skills.RANGED_SPECIALIZATION, Skills.BALLISTIC_MASTERY, person);
3416                
3417                convertSkill(Skills.PHASE_MASTERY, Skills.FIELD_MODULATION, person);
3418                convertSkill(Skills.PHASE_MASTERY, Skills.ORDNANCE_EXPERTISE, person);
3419                
3420                convertSkill(Skills.WEAPON_DRILLS, Skills.TACTICAL_DRILLS, person);
3421                convertSkill(Skills.SPECIAL_MODIFICATIONS, Skills.BEST_OF_THE_BEST, person);
3422                
3423                
3424                removeSkill(Skills.COLONY_MANAGEMENT, person);
3425                removeSkill(Skills.SPACE_OPERATIONS, person);
3426                removeSkill(Skills.PLANETARY_OPERATIONS, person);
3427                removeSkill(Skills.AUXILIARY_SUPPORT, person);
3428
3429                if (person.isAICore() && stats.hasSkill(Skills.INDUSTRIAL_PLANNING)) {
3430                        stats.setSkillLevel(Skills.HYPERCOGNITION, 1);
3431                }
3432                
3433                stats.setSkipRefresh(false);
3434                
3435        }
3436        
3437        public void removeSkill(String id, PersonAPI person) {
3438                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
3439                        person.getStats().decreaseSkill(id);
3440                }
3441        }
3442        public void convertSkill(String from, String to, PersonAPI person) {
3443                int level = (int) person.getStats().getSkillLevel(from);
3444                if (level > 0) {
3445                        for (int i = 0; i < level; i++) {
3446                                person.getStats().decreaseSkill(from);
3447                        }
3448                        person.getStats().setSkillLevel(to, level);
3449                }
3450        }
3451        
3452}
